items.text: Fre'Drisha "Sha" Dixon is an attorney and the founder and managing attorney of Dixon Law Partners. She also founded and leads the Inglewood Coalition for Educational Equity.

sentences.text: Fre'Drisha "Sha" Dixon is an attorney and the founder and managing attorney of Dixon Law Partners.
She also founded and leads the Inglewood Coalition for Educational Equity.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she supported creating term limits for city officials, conducting a forensic audit of city finances, and moving city council meetings to an evening slot. She led a coalition meeting in July 2026 that argued the Inglewood Unified School District is not financially stable, pointing to a projected $13.3 million deficit for the 2025-2026 fiscal year.
